question: 资产规模超过 3000 万的客户有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_asset WHERE total_asset >= 30000000 LIMIT 10

question: 近 30 日的交易金额是多少
golden: SELECT SUM(trade_amount) AS 交易金额 FROM cust_trade WHERE trade_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-30 day') LIMIT 10

question: 各客户画像下的平均持仓成本
golden: SELECT c.archetype AS 客户画像, AVG(h.cost_value) AS 平均持仓成本 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id GROUP BY c.archetype ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 50

question: 持有红利低波组合的客户平均年龄
golden: SELECT AVG(c.age) AS 平均年龄 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.prod_name = '红利低波组合' LIMIT 10

question: 普通客户的人均资产是多少
golden: SELECT SUM(a.total_asset) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.cust_id) AS 人均资产 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id WHERE c.cust_tag = '普通客户' LIMIT 10

question: 近 60 日的净流入是多少
golden: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN flow_type = '流入' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS 净流入 FROM cust_cashflow WHERE flow_date >= date('2026-09-18', '-60 day') LIMIT 10

question: C1 风险等级的客户总资产合计是多少
golden: SELECT SUM(a.total_asset) AS 总资产合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id WHERE c.risk_level = 'C1' LIMIT 10

question: 持有沪深300指数增强的客户有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.prod_name = '沪深300指数增强' LIMIT 10

question: 各客户经理名下的主办客户数（前 5 名）
golden: SELECT m.mgr_name AS 客户经理, COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM mgr_info m JOIN service_relation s ON m.mgr_id = s.mgr_id WHERE s.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY m.mgr_name ORDER BY 客户数 DESC LIMIT 5

question: 各客群标签客户的净流入
golden: SELECT c.cust_tag AS 客群标签, SUM(CASE WHEN f.flow_type = '流入' THEN f.amount ELSE -f.amount END) AS 净流入 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_cashflow f ON c.cust_id = f.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_tag ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 50

question: 固收类产品的持仓市值是多少
golden: SELECT SUM(h.market_value) AS 持仓市值 FROM cust_holding h JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.prod_type = '固收类' LIMIT 10

question: 风险等级 R2 及以上产品的持仓客户有多少人
golden: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS 客户数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.risk_level >= 2 LIMIT 10

question: 各渠道的交易笔数
golden: SELECT c.channel AS 渠道, COUNT(*) AS 交易笔数 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_trade t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id GROUP BY c.channel ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 50

question: 持有医药主题基金的客户的平均持仓市值
golden: SELECT AVG(h.market_value) AS 平均持仓市值 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_holding h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN prod_info p ON h.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE p.prod_name = '医药主题基金' LIMIT 10

question: 开户在南京鼓楼营业部的客户总资产是多少
golden: SELECT SUM(a.total_asset) AS 总资产合计 FROM cust_info c JOIN cust_asset a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id WHERE c.branch = '南京鼓楼营业部' LIMIT 10
